test_downcast_polymorphic_animals: test the pybind11 tagbased polymorphic module by creating a zoo and verifying animal downcasting works correctly
create_zoo_of_animals: create a zoo of polymorphic animals including Labradors, Dogs, Chihuahuas, Cats, and Panthers using the create_zoo factory function
access_animal_attributes: access animal attributes like name, sound, and excitement on polymorphic objects returned from the tagbased polymorphic module
call_animal_bark_method: call the bark method on dog-type animals in the zoo to get breed-specific bark strings with the animal name
call_animal_purr_method: call the purr method on cat-type animals in the zoo to get species-specific purr sounds
